universe: Exactly all three historical same-seat same-global-turn Statue chains with 2+ accepted casts from original RACE R1 ten-game census, not manually selected good/bad examples.
method: Read only original exact SHA-256 ZIPs; verify completed full game, unchanged R5 pilot, complete accepted actions and seat turn identity. No replay and no full game.

For each original accepted Statue CastSpell in each fixed caster/global-turn, partition the event stream from that accepted CastSpell action through the action immediately before the next Statue CastSpell by same seat; for the final cast, through the end of that source global turn.

Count actual CardsDrawnEvent for that seat by explicit count, real Animar +1/+1 CountersAddedEvent placed by that seat, Statue BATTLEFIELD→HAND exits, and real Purphoros/Walking Ballista player-damage events.
Report every interval, including zero-value ones, with original action index, card draw count, counter amount and exact event counts; no cherry-picking or opponent hand data.

Classify a material observed resource change when an interval contains a seat card draw, its Animar counter or actual payoff player damage; this is not a judgment that taking the line improved win likelihood or beat interaction.
Explicitly report whether Purphoros payoff damage or a same-turn GameEndedEvent occurred and distinguish later game results.
Keep all 57 original cast acts (19+17+21), and never count a regression-only Palinchron as part of this deck.
next: If all repeat chains generated real draw/counter value, do not call them empty loops. Instead select a fresh isolated payoff/finite-exit negative-control regression and evaluate a genuinely mis-sequenced opportunity, or HOLD RACE and retain v0.7. No promotion from this archive audit.
